title: Quanta Services Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
publisher: Quanta Services, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 Electric segment revenue was USD 7.84 billion with 11.5% operating margin; total RPO was USD 33.55 billion and backlog was USD 53.44 billion.
summary: Quanta's unchanged SEC-filed Q2 release confirms record operating results and raised guidance. Electric operating margin expanded to 11.5%; acquisitions add capabilities and expected 2026 contribution but require USD 1.24 billion upfront consideration plus possible contingent payments.
